design_rules: Use the registered probe wrapper exactly and change only the registered consequence-horizon state within each pair.
Downstream prompts are standalone dated-allocation tasks. Use concrete dates or delays without naming immediate focus or long-horizon focus, and include exactly one response contract.
Do not ask the model to label temporal orientation or append any probe continuation sentence.

probe_train.instructions: Generate complete matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Keep consequences, actors, and wording identical within a pair except the registered horizon-salience clause inside Scenario; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_validation.instructions: Generate new matched validation probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper. Change only the registered horizon-salience clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

probe_heldout.instructions: Generate held-out matched probe pairs with the exact registered wrapper and new domains. Change only the registered horizon-salience clause; append nothing after the wrapper.

behavior_eval.instructions: Generate standalone dated-allocation items with assigned metadata. Do not use direct target-state labels; include exactly one two-integer response contract.

steering_eval.instructions: Generate a distinct standalone dated-allocation pool with the same metadata schedule. Avoid direct target-state labels and include exactly one response contract.

calibration.instructions: Generate neutral standalone dated-allocation items for calibration. Avoid horizon labels and include exactly one response contract.
